201.description: One external effect; replays return the same receipt

204.description: State, effects, dedupe records and scenarios cleared

parameters.name: effectIdempotencyKey
parameters.description: Gateway-generated key, not the client request key.

200.description: Effect ledger used by exactly-once conformance tests

mockServiceAuth.description: Local service identity resolved from an opaque secret reference.

localAdminAuth.description: Local/test bootstrap identity; route is absent outside local/test.

payloadHash.description: EXTERNAL_COMMAND: digest of the full payload SchemaBoundValue. PLATFORM_ACTION: exact semantic contentHash of the immutable candidate revision; that branch has no arbitrary payload.

currentPublishedVersion.description: 0 means that no version is currently published; otherwise exact current version.

awp_contracts_commands_capability_comman.title: Capability Command Intent
awp_contracts_commands_capability_comman.description: Typed intent emitted by a Pack. Connector/Profile selection is intentionally absent.

intakeDraftId.description: Source Intake Draft for an acceptance command; no Work Item exists yet.

sourceWorkItemId.description: Existing source Work Item for a post-acceptance command.

idempotencyKey.description: Client/application request idempotency key. Gateway scopes it by actor, Workspace/Project and operation, then creates a separate effect key.

resultWorkItemId.description: Work Item created atomically with confirmation of an intake-sourced acceptance command; absent before that transaction.

idempotencyKey.description: Client/application request idempotency key, interpreted only inside actor + Workspace/Project + operation scope.

effectIdempotencyKey.description: Gateway-generated globally unique stable key sent to the Connector for every attempt; clients cannot choose it.

outboxStatus.description: Durable PostgreSQL delivery state. Expired LEASED/ENQUEUED may return to READY; ACKNOWLEDGED may return to READY with a new generation when a non-terminal command execution lease expires.

executionLeaseExpiresAt.description: Diagnostic expiry only; the lease token is internal and never exposed.

terminalResult.description: Normalized success, conflict or final failure; never a raw vendor response.

entitlementRefs.description: Empty only in an enclosing WORKSPACE-scoped contract; PROJECT-scoped contracts refine this array to at least one exact entitlement ref.

WorkspaceAuthorizationBasis.description: Closed authorization provenance for a Workspace-scoped resource. Project Entitlement is not fabricated and the exact entitlement set is empty.

ProjectAuthorizationBasis.description: Closed authorization provenance for a Project-scoped resource or effect.

awp_contracts_commands_external_command_.title: External Command Delivery Job
awp_contracts_commands_external_command_.description: Minimal BullMQ payload. Worker MUST load and compare the durable command envelope before any effect.

awp_contracts_common_schema_bound_value_.title: Schema Bound Value
awp_contracts_common_schema_bound_value_.description: The wrapper is generic; value MUST be validated against the registered exact schemaRef before use.

quarantineClassificationKey.description: Conservative classification assigned to every raw webhook receipt before connector parsing and Project resolution.

dataClassificationKey.description: Classification of this configuration resource itself, independent of transported payload ceilings.

validationReportId.description: Exact successful immutable Validation Report that authorized the transition out of DRAFT; excluded from contentHash to avoid a circular fingerprint.

awp_contracts_integration_connector_mapp.title: Connector Mapping Version
awp_contracts_integration_connector_mapp.description: Immutable schema-bound mapping resource. Core stores and versions the payload but does not interpret vendor mapping semantics.

validationReportId.description: Exact successful immutable Validation Report that authorized the transition out of DRAFT; excluded from contentHash to avoid a circular fingerprint.
Exact successful immutable Validation Report that authorized the transition out of DRAFT; excluded from contentHash to avoid a circular fingerprint.

OperationConfiguration.description: Effect is copied from and must equal the exact Capability Contract operation; it enables local conditional validation.

awp_contracts_integration_project_integr.title: Project Integration Binding Version
awp_contracts_integration_project_integr.description: Core contract contains only generic typed capability entries. Pack-specific suite or domain configuration is not embedded here.

validationReportId.description: Exact successful immutable Validation Report that authorized the transition out of DRAFT; excluded from contentHash to avoid a circular fingerprint.

ImmutableContentRef.description: Exact reference to a singleton immutable/content-addressed row that has no independent revision number.

QaRequestExtensionSnapshotRef.description: Exact content snapshot of a mutable QA Request Extension at one CAS resource version.

QaRequestInputRevisionRef.description: Exact append-only QA request-input revision selected by the stable QA Request Extension pointer.

QaWaiverRef.description: Exact immutable QA waiver decision revision; live scope, state, expiry, rule and input-fingerprint checks remain mandatory at consumption time.

RequiredSessionPlanRef.description: Exact immutable Required Session Plan revision evaluated by a session, manifest, verdict or completion decision.

RequiredSessionRequirementRef.description: Exact requirement within one immutable Required Session Plan revision; the Session is coverage for this key/ordinal only.

RiskReviewPolicyRef.description: Exact immutable project-scoped Risk Review Policy version; unlike semantic DoR/DoD/evidence rule refs, this never follows a stable-key pointer.

ResponseChannelRef.description: Exact provider-neutral response channel resolved and confirmed by the server. Feature 002 seeds only the in-platform web channel; future adapters may version a broader schema.

PreviousSessionRef.description: Typed prior Session lineage for RETEST. US1 can pin a validated immutable external historical record before QA Session tables exist; later revisions may pin a same-scope reviewed QA Session.

DeclaredBlocker.description: Requester-declared blocker fact; readiness rules decide whether it is hard, informational, resolved or waived.

GenericApprovalRef.description: Reference only. Exact subject remains owned by the generic Core Approval Gateway.

ArtifactRef.description: Provider-neutral metadata reference; locator and signed URL are forbidden.

awp_schemas_qa_scoped_envelope_v1.title: Project-scoped QA Resource Envelope
awp_schemas_qa_scoped_envelope_v1.description: Server-produced envelope. Actor and authoritative scope are never accepted from a mutation body.

awp_schemas_qa_event_envelope_v1.title: QA Alias to the Published Project-scoped Event Envelope
awp_schemas_qa_event_envelope_v1.description: No QA-specific transport fork. Payload specialization is defined in qa-events.v1.schema.json.

RequestInputRevisedPayload.description: Emitted in the same transaction that advances the stable current-input pointer and invalidates stale pre-READY decisions/candidates.

SessionStateChangedPayload.description: Closed legal transition event. Envelope actor/occurredAt plus authorizationBasisHash provide human transition provenance; reachedMilestone preserves terminal history.

frozenFindingReviewRefs.description: Canonical ordered unique complete set frozen by the same Session-review UoW. Empty for a clean US3 review; once Findings are installed it contains every exact FROZEN successor created atomically with the review and manifest.

DodSatisfiedPayload.description: Emitted only by the generic confirmation UoW after the distinct-QA-Lead-approved transition is externally confirmed as DONE.

awp_schemas_qa_intake_v1.title: QA Validation Intake Payload
awp_schemas_qa_intake_v1.description: Client-supplied Pack payload. Workspace, Project, actor, role, entitlement and the exact confirmed response channel are derived by the server and are therefore forbidden here.

awp_schemas_operational_work_item_comple.title: Deterministic Provider-neutral QA Completion Summary
awp_schemas_operational_work_item_comple.description: Closed, hash-covered content rendered by an operational Connector as the external completion comment. Links are platform-relative and never provider locators or credentials.

rejectionRef.description: Exact append-only rejected DefectDraft projection; semantic equality requires this ref to equal the sole defectDraftRefs member.

Receipt.description: Sanitized proof that the same hash-covered summary was materialized by the external completion effect/read-back; no provider response body is retained.

awp_schemas_operational_work_item_result.title: Normalized Operational Work Item Result
awp_schemas_operational_work_item_result.description: Typed confirmed value embedded in the generic ExternalCommandResult receipt. Generic read-back/reconciliation is a confirmation strategy, not an operation.

awp_schemas_operational_work_item_target.title: Operational Work Item Target
awp_schemas_operational_work_item_target.description: Logical scoped target. Provider URL/project key/Profile/Connection/secret are forbidden.

description.description: Optional exact human goal/scope text; omitted when the confirmed Draft has no DoR-semantic description.

acceptanceOutcome.description: Optional exact human acceptance outcome; omitted rather than invented when absent.

awp_schemas_qa_completion_candidate_v1.title: QA Completion Candidate with CAS Delivery Projection
awp_schemas_qa_completion_candidate_v1.description: The close-intent content, including the server-derived adjudicativeAggregateHash, is immutable and exact-approved by a distinct, currently authorized QA Lead. State and generic approval/command/confirmation refs form the mutable CAS delivery projection; final confirmation also creates a separate append-only record. HUMAN REJECTED is reachable only from AWAITING_APPROVAL through the exact generic Approval rejection; a pre-approval aggregate change uses CANDIDATE to INVALIDATED instead. Dispatch succeeds only when the extension-owned aggregate hash still matches and the extension completion guard is atomically moved to DISPATCHED before outbox publication.

adjudicativeAggregateHash.description: Server-derived extension aggregate digest pinned when the immutable candidate is created. Dispatch atomically rechecks equality with QaRequestExtension.adjudicativeAggregateHash; mismatch invalidates a pre-dispatch candidate with zero Connector call.

completionSummaryHash.description: Must equal transitionInput.completionSummaryHash. Semantic conformance also deep-compares the top-level plan/DoD/Verdict/manifest/Finding/defect/scope/residual-risk projection to the same full transitionInput.completionSummary bytes before Approval creation and dispatch.

contentHash.description: Hash of immutable close-intent fields, including adjudicativeAggregateHash; excludes state, closeApprovalRef, commandRef, finalCloseConfirmationRef and terminalReason delivery projection fields.

initiatorRole.description: Server-derived authorization projection. Only the current HUMAN Executor may initiate final close; a QA Lead cannot initiate even when the same person could otherwise approve another subject.

terminalFromState.description: Exact pre-dispatch state invalidated by drift. DISPATCHED is deliberately excluded: after dispatch only confirmation, failure or reconciliation may follow.

DispatchedDeliveryProjection.description: The exact approved command is durably DISPATCHED and owns the extension aggregate lock. No terminal/confirmation projection exists yet.

ConfirmedDeliveryProjection.description: Confirmed close projection. A terminal reason is impossible because generic confirmation succeeded.

FailedDeliveryProjection.description: FAILED is reachable only after dispatch and preserves the exact approved command/effect provenance while forbidding any confirmation projection. The same reconciliation transaction releases QaRequestExtension.completionDispatchGuard back to OPEN; it never rewrites this terminal candidate history.

InvalidatedDeliveryProjection.description: Pre-dispatch invalidation preserves exactly the projection owned by its predecessor state and forbids confirmation/dispatch provenance not yet reached.

RejectedDeliveryProjection.description: Exact generic Approval rejection. This is the sole HUMAN rejection branch and therefore proves AWAITING_APPROVAL as its predecessor; CANDIDATE is invalidated, never rejected.

allOf.description: Cross-field semantic invariant: requiredSessionPlanRef, verdictRef and dodAssessmentRef equal their transitionInput refs; scopeSummary and residualRisk equal completionSummary text; adjudicativeManifestRevisionRefs equal completionSummary evidence manifest refs; findingReviewRefs/defectDraftRefs/defectLinkIds equal the flattened completionSummary defect refs; completionSummaryHash equals the nested digest. Any mismatch is a conformance failure before exact Approval subject creation.

awp_schemas_qa_defect_draft_proposal_v1.title: Non-authoritative QA Defect Draft Wording Proposal
awp_schemas_qa_defect_draft_proposal_v1.description: Optional wording-only assistant output over one exact frozen Finding review. It cannot approve, publish, mutate a Finding or create a DefectDraft; a human must explicitly accept the exact proposalHash through the draft-create operation.

awp_schemas_qa_defect_draft_v1.title: QA Defect Draft with Immutable Payload and CAS Delivery Projection
awp_schemas_qa_defect_draft_v1.description: Candidate payload and contentHash are immutable. Human decision and generic approval/command/link lifecycle fields are a guarded CAS projection. Wording replacement first INVALIDATES the current pre-dispatch head; an exact successor version is accepted only from the current FAILED or INVALIDATED head. REJECTED and LINKED are chain-terminal, and a confirmed one-per-Finding DefectLink forbids any later candidate.

terminalFromState.description: Exact last nonterminal lifecycle state whose delivery projection is preserved by INVALIDATED or FAILED.

contentHash.description: Hash of immutable candidate payload fields; excludes CAS delivery projection fields.

sessionReviewRefs.description: Exact input inventory; may be absent or empty only while BLOCKED. READY_TO_CLOSE and SATISFIED require at least one reviewed Session.

adjudicativeManifestRevisionRefs.description: Exact input inventory; may be absent or empty only while BLOCKED. READY_TO_CLOSE and SATISFIED require adjudicative evidence.

waiverRefs.description: Exact immutable QaWaiver decision refs only. Semantic dereference accepts approved/unexpired SESSION, PLAN_ITEM or REQUIRED_SESSION kinds; the generic platform action remains reachable through each waiver and is not a substitute ref.

EvaluationCommand.description: Server-derived DoD inventory trigger. DISCOVER_BLOCKERS permits evaluation when Verdict/plan/evidence are absent and forbids caller-authored closure hints. ASSERT_READY_TO_CLOSE pins exact plan/Verdict hints, but the server still derives and revalidates the complete same-scope inventory under aggregate CAS.

displayLabel.description: Non-normative presentation text. It is excluded from adjudication and may be clerically corrected after close.

signedManifestMemberRefs.description: Exact immutable manifest-member snapshots that have already pinned this link. Their content hashes never change when current availability changes.

awp_schemas_qa_evidence_attachment_sessi.title: Scoped QA Evidence Attachment Session
awp_schemas_qa_evidence_attachment_sessi.description: Authorized proxy-upload lifecycle. contentUploadRef is opaque and never reveals a provider locator or presigned URL.

awp_schemas_qa_evidence_manifest_history.title: Scoped Evidence Manifest Revision History Projection
awp_schemas_qa_evidence_manifest_history.description: Read-only projection exposing latest and adjudicative pointers separately, plus append-only post-close marker rows that explain non-adjudicative clerical revisions.

resourceVersion.description: Stable manifest-header CAS owner. If-Match on post-close correction compares this value; Session ETags are not used.

awp_schemas_qa_evidence_manifest_member_.title: Immutable Evidence Manifest Member Snapshot
awp_schemas_qa_evidence_manifest_member_.description: Signed metadata snapshot. availabilityAtSigning is historical and never follows the mutable current availability projection of EvidenceArtifactLink.

allOf.description: Cross-revision semantic invariant: CLERICAL_CORRECTION must keep the same manifestId and preserve plan/item/Attempt/Observation/result/outcome/flags/snapshots/review/Finding/policy/provenance bytes from previousRevisionRef. Only correction metadata and non-normative display text (represented by a newly content-addressed member if necessary), revision timestamps/signature and resulting hashes may differ. CI performs an explicit previous-vs-current semantic diff; schema shape alone is insufficient.

dispositionReason.description: Exact human disposition reason from the frozen Finding review; for DUPLICATE this and duplicateDefectRef are an inseparable normalized pair.

clericalAnnotations.description: Ordered non-adjudicative post-close annotations. The enclosing revision permits this field only for CLERICAL_CORRECTION; these bytes are included in manifest contentHash and signature.

awp_schemas_qa_final_close_confirmation_.title: Append-only QA Final Close Confirmation
awp_schemas_qa_final_close_confirmation_.description: Created only by the generic confirmation UoW after the distinct-QA-Lead-approved request.transition is externally observed as DONE.

awp_schemas_qa_finding_observation_membe.title: Scoped Finding Observation Membership
awp_schemas_qa_finding_observation_membe.description: Append-only assignment row with a one-way audited release projection. Scope, actor and timestamps are server-derived. Reassignment creates a new membership row; an existing row is never reactivated.

previousRevisionRef.description: Exact immediately preceding revision of this same Finding review aggregate. Version 1 is CLASSIFIED and has no predecessor. Later CLASSIFIED revisions represent reclassification; DISPOSED must succeed CLASSIFIED and FROZEN must succeed DISPOSED, enforced by same-scope semantic validation.

awp_schemas_qa_manual_attempt_v1.title: Append-only Manual Attempt
awp_schemas_qa_manual_attempt_v1.description: Each execution is a new record; Plan Item result is intentionally not reused as canonical Attempt result.

attemptMembershipMode.description: The service derived consideredAttemptRefs from every finalized Attempt for this PlanItem, ordered by contiguous attemptNo 1..maximumAttemptNo; a caller cannot select a subset.

consideredAttemptRefs.description: Complete server-derived finalized Attempt membership, never a caller-selected subset.

observationMembershipMode.description: The service derived consideredObservationRefs from every current leaf Observation for the complete finalized Attempt set; a caller cannot select a subset or an obsolete corrected parent.

consideredObservationRefs.description: Exact canonical Observation set considered by this human result. Semantic validation requires same-scope/same-PlanItem rows; every considered negative technical Attempt must be covered by at least one NEGATIVE or AMBIGUOUS Observation that references that exact Attempt.

FlakyDispositionBasis.description: Exact current DISPOSED Finding basis used when fail-to-pass execution is recorded as PASS + FLAKY_SUSPECTED. It deliberately cannot point at a future FROZEN review. Session review rechecks this same-scope membership/policy snapshot and creates the FROZEN successor atomically with review and manifest publication.

failedAttemptRefs.description: Complete exact subset of considered Attempts whose technical result is ASSERTION_FAILED, INFRA_FAILED, TIMEOUT or INCOMPLETE.

flakyObservationRefs.description: Complete exact NEGATIVE/AMBIGUOUS Observation set covering failedAttemptRefs. Each row must be same-PlanItem, reference one exact failed Attempt and be active in the pinned Finding membership set.

FlakyDispositionDecision.description: Closed flaky truth table: FLAKY_SUSPECTED is legal only with PASS or INCONCLUSIVE. PASS + FLAKY_SUSPECTED requires the exact current DISPOSED basis; INCONCLUSIVE + FLAKY_SUSPECTED forbids that future-dependent basis. FAIL, BLOCKED and NOT_RUN forbid the flag. Without the flag, every result forbids the basis.

RevisionCommand.description: Append-only human result command. A null predecessor is initial and forbids correctionReason; a non-null exact predecessor is a correction and requires the bounded reason.

expectedAttemptSetHash.description: CAS hint for the complete server-derived finalized Attempt set; mismatch or a later repeat rejects the command before a result revision is written.

expectedObservationSetHash.description: CAS hint for the complete server-derived current-leaf Observation set; mismatch, correction or late Observation rejects the command.

NegativeObservationDecision.description: Every executed result is not recordable without a nonempty exact current-leaf Observation set. PASS additionally requires at least one POSITIVE Observation; FAIL/BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE require at least one NEGATIVE or AMBIGUOUS Observation. Kind/leaf/attempt coverage is a transactional semantic invariant.

CommandObservationDecision.description: The public command carries only CAS facts for the complete server-derived current-leaf Observation set. NOT_RUN expects zero; every executed result expects a nonempty set.

RevisionPredecessorDecision.description: Public result-revision predecessor/reason truth table. Null means initial and forbids correctionReason; an exact non-null predecessor requires it.

awp_schemas_qa_post_close_correction_mar.title: Append-only Post-close Correction Marker
awp_schemas_qa_post_close_correction_mar.description: Marks a clerical correction after confirmed DONE. It never supersedes or retroactively changes the signed Verdict or DoD assessment.

finalCloseConfirmationRef.description: Exact append-only confirmation ID proving that this Work Item was externally observed as DONE before the clerical correction was accepted.

authorizationBasisHash.description: Server-derived live HUMAN authorization snapshot. It is never accepted from the mutation body.

awp_schemas_qa_backlog_item_v1.title: Confirmed QA Backlog Item Projection
awp_schemas_qa_backlog_item_v1.description: Reload-safe list/detail item after request-input semantics moved to append-only revisions; the stable header alone intentionally does not duplicate title or DoR content.

allowedResponseChannelKinds.description: Server-resolved response-channel kinds allowed by this immutable project context. Feature 002 intentionally seeds no Mattermost runtime.

allowedChecklistPolicyRefs.description: Closed exact checklist-policy catalog for this immutable context version. It is distinct from the default subset.

allOf.description: Semantic conformance requires each default target/scope ref and every default checklist ref to be byte-equal to a member of the corresponding closed allowlist. Plan publication accepts only target, scope and checklist members of this exact context version; defaults are not treated as the whole catalog.

awp_schemas_qa_request_extension_v1.title: Stable QA Request Extension Header
awp_schemas_qa_request_extension_v1.description: Pack-owned header for a confirmed generic Work Item and the single CAS owner for adjudicative mutations. Mutable pre-READY semantics live only in append-only QaRequestInputRevision rows selected by currentRequestInputRevisionRef; this header contains no external authority-owned status. completionDispatchGuard is the authoritative aggregate lock projection exposed by detail reads, never a second completion authority.

requiredSessionPlanRef.description: Absent during US1. US2 publishes the first immutable plan revision and atomically sets this exact latest pointer.

adjudicativeAggregateHash.description: Server-derived canonical digest of the exact current adjudicative input/readiness/plan/session/evidence/Finding/defect/Verdict/DoD pointers. Every adjudicative mutation advances this digest under the extension resourceVersion CAS; clients cannot supply it as authority.

contentHash.description: Canonical hash of this stable header/pointer, adjudicativeAggregateHash and completionDispatchGuard snapshot at resourceVersion; semantic request content has its own immutable revision hash.

CompletionDispatchGuard.description: Closed extension-owned completion race guard. OPEN permits an adjudicative mutation under the same extension CAS. DISPATCHED means the exact candidate and command were atomically locked before the outbox write, so every adjudicative mutation is rejected. FAILED reconciliation releases the extension back to OPEN; confirmed external DONE advances it to DONE_FROZEN.

awp_schemas_qa_request_input_history_v1.title: Scoped QA Request Input History Projection

awp_schemas_qa_request_input_revision_v1.title: Append-only QA Request Input Revision
awp_schemas_qa_request_input_revision_v1.description: Scope-safe, content-addressed pre-READY input revision. Revision 1 freezes the structural identity tuple (scope/work item, definition, accepted draft, external request, operational Binding, original requester, title, request kind and classification). Later public commands expose only DoR-semantic fields; the server carries this tuple byte-for-byte and application plus insert-time DB guards reject drift. DoR-semantic fields may be absent so NEEDS_INFO is representable. The server, never the client, records the response-channel resolution. Revision after confirmed operational READY or Session creation is forbidden by the domain service.

RevisionCommand.description: HUMAN DoR-semantic replacement command. It deliberately cannot carry authoritative scope/work-item/definition/draft/external-request/Binding/original-requester/title/request-kind/classification fields. The server reads the exact expected predecessor, copies its frozen structural identity tuple, re-resolves the original requester's response channel and compares the tuple with revision 1 in the application and DB insert guard. reason is mandatory and persists as changeReason.

RevisionReason.description: Request-side audit tuple reused by conformance vectors; every human revision has both a closed reason code and bounded free text.

DorSemanticInput.description: Closed full-replacement body for mutable DoR semantics only. Omission remains meaningful for post-confirmation NEEDS_INFO. Frozen structural identity and response-channel authority are intentionally absent.

PartialRequestedTarget.description: May be partial before READY; readiness records exact blocker pointers for missing build/policy, test-data, lease or environment facts.

ResponseChannelResolution.description: Immutable server-resolution result for the original requester. Readiness deterministically projects CONFIRMED to CONFIRMED and MISSING to UNCONFIRMED, preserving requesterPrincipal, resolutionPolicyRef and evaluatedAt byte-for-byte. CONFIRMED preserves the exact responseChannelRef and forbids a missing reason; MISSING preserves the exact missingReasonCode and forbids a channel ref.

InvalidatedState.description: Exact append-only audit projection of decisions/candidates invalidated by advancing the stable current-input pointer.

ReadyEffectGuard.description: Shared aggregate CAS proof. A revision is valid only while no READY command is DISPATCHED/in-flight; a pending not-yet-dispatched command is invalidated by the same transaction.

awp_schemas_qa_verdict_v1.title: Append-only QA Verdict Content with Signature Projection
awp_schemas_qa_verdict_v1.description: Exact immutable verdict content pins reviewed Sessions and adjudicative evidence. status/signatureRefs are the guarded signature/supersession projection; the contentHash never changes. Upstream drift does not mutate or invalidate a signed Verdict: the current selector rejects stale exact refs, while explicit human revision is the sole SIGNED-to-SUPERSEDED unit of work.

contentHash.description: Hash of immutable verdict content; excludes status/signature/supersession projection fields.

revisionReason.description: Why this incoming Verdict content revision replaces the exact prior revision. Distinct from the old revision's outgoing supersessionReason.

awp_schemas_qa_waiver_v1.title: Immutable Exact QA Waiver Subject with Decision Projection
awp_schemas_qa_waiver_v1.description: The version/content hash pins scope, rule, input fingerprint, subject, reason, expiry and risk policy. Decision provenance is a CAS projection; distinct live-authorized QA Lead enforcement remains a domain/Approval invariant.

DorSubjectSelector.description: Selects one exact readiness assessment. The server verifies the sole allowlisted blocker and derives the immutable aggregate snapshot; no caller-supplied generic subject is trusted.

PlanItemSubjectSelector.description: Selects a same-scope Plan Item by ID. The server resolves its current resourceVersion and aggregate snapshot under CAS before creating the immutable candidate.

SessionSubjectSelector.description: Selects a same-scope Session by ID. The server resolves its current resourceVersion and aggregate snapshot under CAS before creating the immutable candidate.

RequiredSessionSubjectSelector.description: Pins one exact requirement inside one immutable Required Session Plan revision.

FindingSubjectSelector.description: Pins one exact frozen Finding review revision; the negative evidence remains unaffected.

WaiverSubjectSelector.description: Closed public selector union. PLAN_ITEM and SESSION selectors are deliberately IDs, not caller-authored snapshots; the server resolves and hashes their current same-scope resource under CAS.

WaiverSubjectRef.description: Server-derived immutable typed subject persisted in the waiver candidate. Every branch includes the exact aggregate snapshot hash used by Approval and consumption-time revalidation.

awp_schemas_qa_work_item_detail_v1.title: Scoped QA Work Item Detail and History Projection
awp_schemas_qa_work_item_detail_v1.description: One reload-safe read model for the walking-skeleton UI. Every array is same Workspace/Project/Work Item scope and preserves append-only histories rather than only latest values. requestExtension.completionDispatchGuard is the single authoritative aggregate-lock projection; completionCandidates is history and never a competing lock authority.

requestExtension.description: Includes adjudicativeAggregateHash and the authoritative OPEN|DISPATCHED|DONE_FROZEN completionDispatchGuard used to explain mutation availability after reload.

OperationalReadinessProjection.description: Derived UI projection only: canonical readiness authority remains the immutable assessment. The closed state matrix is normative: NOT_EVALUATED and NEEDS_INFO remain Core NEW without effects; READY_PENDING_SYNC and SYNC_ERROR remain NEW; confirmed READY preserves the readiness fact while Core may advance through READY or any later canonical lifecycle state.

oneOf.description: 002 models SYNC_ERROR before a confirmed result; terminal result payloads remain in command/result history and are not projected here.

awp_schemas_qa_readiness_assessment_v1.title: Append-only QA Readiness Assessment with Exact DoR Inputs
awp_schemas_qa_readiness_assessment_v1.description: Deterministic human-evaluated DoR snapshot. It never stores the derived external sync stage; the read model combines this canonical assessment with Core operational projection.

WaivableReadinessBlockerCode.description: Feature-002 hardcoded DoR waiver allowlist. Every structural/content, scope, security, classification, entitlement, channel, RETEST and Binding/Profile rule remains non-waivable.

ReadyWithWaiverProjectRegistryInput.description: READY_WITH_WAIVER specialization. A pre-waiver NEEDS_INFO assessment may carry NEEDS_REVIEW without this ref; only the new waived-ready assessment requires the exact approved DoR waiver.

ResponseChannelInput.description: DoR projection of the exact pinned QaRequestInputRevision responseChannelResolution. Source CONFIRMED maps to CONFIRMED; source MISSING maps to UNCONFIRMED. requesterPrincipal, resolutionPolicyRef and evaluatedAt are byte-for-byte equal. CONFIRMED preserves the exact responseChannelRef and forbids missingReasonCode; UNCONFIRMED preserves the exact source missingReasonCode and forbids responseChannelRef.

ContentCompletenessInput.description: Closed projection over the exact request-input revision so a READY assessment cannot hide absent non-waivable DoR facts behind an opaque fingerprint.

desiredDate.description: Typed projection of the exact request-input revision desiredDate; absence remains explicit and is a non-waivable DoR blocker.

checklistSelection.description: Closed checklist provenance. REQUEST_INPUT refs must be byte-equal to the pinned request-input revision checklistRefs; PROJECT_CONTEXT_DEFAULTS refs must be byte-equal to the pinned context defaultChecklistRefs. MISSING is the only empty branch and is a non-waivable blocker.

awp_schemas_qa_required_session_plan_his.title: Scoped Required Session Plan History Projection

currentRevisionRef.description: Null only for the stable empty bootstrap header before the first publication.

awp_schemas_qa_required_session_plan_v1.title: Immutable Required Session Plan Revision
awp_schemas_qa_required_session_plan_v1.description: Content-addressed plan revision. Changes create a new revision; consumers pin {id,revision,contentHash}.

requestExtensionSnapshotRef.description: Exact content-addressed snapshot of the QA Request Extension inputs used to publish this plan revision.

requestInputRevisionRef.description: Exact append-only DoR content revision selected by requestExtensionSnapshotRef when this plan revision was published.

projectContextPolicySetHash.description: Canonical hash of the exact context target/scope/checklist allowlists used to validate every slot policy ref.

dorInputFingerprint.description: Exact readiness-assessment input fingerprint revalidated for publication, including any same-scope DoR waiver subject/rule/fingerprint/expiry.

PublicationCommand.description: HUMAN publication command. INITIAL is exactly the null-predecessor branch; every revision reason requires an exact current predecessor and aggregate If-Match.

PublicationPredecessorDecision.description: Closed reason/predecessor truth table used by the public publication command: INITIAL iff no current plan; every other reason iff an exact current predecessor exists.

OperationalReadinessProof.description: Confirmed generic request.transition(READY) proof plus the current pre-DONE Core projection. carriedForwardFromRequirementRef.description: Exact prior-revision requirement lineage. Prior completed Sessions count only when this ref has the same stable requirementKey, ordinal and contentHash as the current REQUIRED slot; any content change omits the ref and requires new Session coverage.

structureHash.description: Digest of the current structural revision. A structural edit advances both structureRevision and this hash.

readyAgainstStructureHash.description: Null while PLANNED. READY and every later reached milestone pin the exact structureHash against which readiness was established; start requires byte equality with current structureHash.

interruptedFromState.description: Immediate predecessor for BLOCKED/CANCELLED. CANCELLED may follow BLOCKED; reachedMilestone separately preserves the furthest nonterminal execution stage.

awp_schemas_004_intake_candidate_v1.title: IntakeCandidate v1
awp_schemas_004_intake_candidate_v1.$comment: Every Candidate has expiresAt. Semantic validation requires snoozedUntil < expiresAt for SNOOZED. Effective state evaluates expiry first: now >= expiresAt is EXPIRED; otherwise a SNOOZED candidate with now >= snoozedUntil is PENDING_CONFIRMATION.

currentDecisionVersion.description: Required after a human decision; optional in PENDING_CONFIRMATION and EXPIRED because both states are reachable without a decision.

awp_schemas_004_interaction_intent_v1.title: InteractionIntent v1
awp_schemas_004_interaction_intent_v1.$comment: Composed validation enforces all same-scope references and temporal inequalities; unique AEAD nonce per key version; exact key identity/purpose/decrypt horizon; contiguous unique presentation slots; equality with the parent NotificationIntent ordered action set, command, capability, effect-key hash, target/payload/render hashes; DM principal equality; and callback team/channel/post equality with the immutable presentation delivery result. These semantic/ref constraints are in addition to JSON Schema shape validation.
awp_schemas_004_interaction_intent_v1.description: Project-scoped server-side exact intent. PROJECT_SELECT is issued only after canonical OIDC authentication and uses WEB transport; later Mattermost callbacks use project-scoped configuration plus a safe reference to recoverable sealed presentation material. The raw opaque token is never serialized by this schema.

returnOnceTokenHandling.description: WEB project-selection token returned only in the fresh authenticated response and never persisted in recoverable form.

sealedPresentationTokenHandling.description: Safe commitments for one token slot in a bounded project-scoped interactive presentation. AWP_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 is RFC 8785 JCS serialized as UTF-8 without BOM/newline and must validate as InteractionPresentationAadV1, including retainUntil. The composed validator resolves the capsule and immutable key version, requires retainUntil <= intent.expiresAt <= key.decryptUntil, verifies the exact NotificationIntent/command/capability/effect/target/payload/render bindings, aadHash and post-decrypt nonceHash. Plaintext is available only through a one-shot fenced SensitiveValue lease and is never serialized here.

presentationKeyVersionRef.description: Immutable Core envelope-key metadata. The composed validator requires exact top-level scope/environment equality, a distinct resolved identity from every bot/gateway credential, no cross-Project alias, and decryptUntil covering the capsule recovery horizon.

principalDmTarget.description: Logical target used before the provider creates/resolves a DM channel. principalId must equal the intent actor and the delivery result later pins the provider channel/post used for callback verification.

interactionResponseTarget.description: Routes through the immutable delivery/result of an already consumed source interaction; it is distinct from the newly presented action intent IDs.

projectSelectActionParameters.description: The exact selected Project and authorization snapshot are already pinned by projectId and the PROJECT_SELECTION subject.

candidateSnoozeActionParameters.description: Pins the exact Candidate snapshots and bounded dialog contract; the user-entered snoozedUntil is validated on submission and is not pre-authorized by the intent.

draftRevisionSubmitActionParameters.description: subject.id/version/contentHash pin revisionId, revision and contentHash; this object adds the Draft header CAS and exact rendered form hash.

draftConfirmActionParameters.description: subject.id/version/contentHash pin revisionId, revision and contentHash; this object adds the Draft header CAS and immutable confirmation summary hash.

openWebActionParameters.description: The allowlisted navigation target and its exact version/hash are already pinned by the WEB_ROUTE subject.

awp_schemas_004_interaction_presentation.title: InteractionPresentationAadV1
awp_schemas_004_interaction_presentation.$comment: AWP_CANONICAL_JSON_V1 is exactly the UTF-8 encoding, without BOM or trailing newline, of the RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme serialization of this closed object. Mutable intent state/result fields, ciphertextHash, aadHash, AEAD nonce, auth tag and ciphertext are deliberately excluded. The composed validator requires this object to be reconstructed from the exact referenced InteractionIntent/capsule commitments and requires its schemaRef digest to match this registry document.

awp_schemas_004_interaction_presentation.title: Interaction Presentation AEAD Golden Vector v1

awp_schemas_004_mattermost_pilot_metadat.title: MattermostPilotMetadataPackage v1
awp_schemas_004_mattermost_pilot_metadat.$comment: The composed-package validator requires every package in one contour to pin the same fixed authority-free bootstrap continuation/evidence, resolves those artifacts, requires both Mattermost and bootstrap URLs to be loopback for LOCAL and TLS for DEVELOPMENT/TEST, and verifies every transitive project Connection/Profile/callback-contract/evidence digest, scope, role, credential fingerprint and policy constraint. The resolved Profile reconciliationMode must have the matching validated server capability: PENDING_POST_ID_LOOKUP requires pendingPostIdLookupSupported, EFFECT_MARKER_LOOKUP requires effectMarkerLookupSupported, and NONE_AMBIGUOUS requires neither. When callbacks are enabled it also resolves immutable project/environment-scoped presentation-key metadata and a measured retention policy/evidence, rejects bot/gateway/foreign-Project identity aliasing, requires each retainUntil-createdAt <= maxCapsuleLifetimeSeconds, expirySweepIntervalSeconds <= expiryPurgeSlaSeconds, decryptUntil to cover every retainUntil, key access disabled by decryptUntil + keyDisableSlaSeconds, and active/WAL/backup settings no greater than their declared bounds. The bootstrap has no Connection or credential and cannot create durable state.

bootstrapContinuationRef.description: Versioned non-secret configuration that resolves to the one fixed first-party OIDC continuation rendered by the stateless /awp create bootstrap.

bootstrapValidationEvidenceRef.description: Immutable evidence that the public bootstrap response is static, bounded, authority-free and creates no durable state.

projectConnectionRef.description: Project-scoped Mattermost Connection whose external credential authority must not exceed this package's Workspace, Project and environment.

ingressContractRefs.description: Project-scoped dialog/post-action callback contracts. Empty only when callbackAuthentication is DISABLED.

projectCredentialSecretRefs.description: Project/environment-scoped Mattermost bot and optional callback-gateway credential references.

presentationTokenEncryptionKeyRef.description: Immutable Core-owned project/environment-scoped envelope-key metadata used only to AEAD-seal transient Mattermost callback-presentation tokens. The composed validator resolves the exact version, rejects bot/gateway/cross-Project identity aliasing and requires its decrypt horizon to cover every capsule retainUntil.

presentationTokenRetention.description: Measured non-production recovery/erasure bounds plus immutable policy and validation evidence. Cross-field and infrastructure checks are performed by the composed-package validator.

callbackAuthentication.description: Explicitly DISABLED when the optional messaging.callback capability is not published.

channelIds.description: Exact channels for this one Project only.

awp_schemas_004_mattermost_profile_v1.title: MattermostProfile v1
awp_schemas_004_mattermost_profile_v1.$comment: This Profile is valid only after Project scope is known; public bootstrap and project selection are outside Profile content. Publication additionally enforces baseBackoffMs <= maxBackoffMs, uniqueness of each (teamId, channelId, purpose) tuple within the Profile, and active channel/bot/credential/Connection isolation across Projects.

ingressContractRefs.description: Exact project-scoped dialog/post-action callback contracts; empty when messaging.callback is not published.

reconciliationMode.description: Immutable delivery recovery mode. Composed publication requires the selected lookup mode to be supported by validated pilot/server evidence; NONE_AMBIGUOUS performs no lookup and terminates uncertainty directly.

awp_schemas_004_notification_intent_v1.title: NotificationIntent v1
awp_schemas_004_notification_intent_v1.$comment: Composed validation maps MESSAGE to exactly one messaging.notify command and INTERACTION_PRESENTATION to exactly one messaging.callback command. The latter requires an ordered contiguous set of 1-8 same-scope InteractionIntents/capsules whose parent presentation/command/target/configuration/effect commitments match this object. target.sourceInteractionIntentId is routing authority for an existing delivery result and must never equal or substitute for a newly presented action ID. reconciliationRef.kind must equal the immutable Profile reconciliationMode; NONE_AMBIGUOUS transitions directly to AMBIGUOUS and is never LOOKUP_REQUIRED. The ref must resolve to the exact fenced delivery attempt for connectorCommandId that owns effectInvocationStartedAt: pendingPostId is byte-for-byte equal to that attempt's immutable pending ID, or effectMarkerHash equals SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 marker bytes stored by that attempt. Cross-command, cross-attempt or recomputed selector substitution is rejected before lookup.

oneOf.description: Route an update through the immutable delivery result of a consumed source interaction. This source ID is not one of the newly presented action IDs.
One provider presentation with an ordered bounded set of independently single-use actions. The IDs are presentation content, not routing targets.

effectKey.description: SHA-256 commitment to the exact bounded Connector effect-idempotency-key string; the raw command key is not represented by this field.

reconciliationRef.description: Safe immutable reconciliation selector matching the pinned Profile mode. Exact provider request material remains in the command/attempt record.

pendingPostIdReconciliation.description: Exact immutable pending-post ID copied from the same fenced command attempt that recorded effectInvocationStartedAt; composed validation requires byte-for-byte equality.

effectMarkerReconciliation.description: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 deterministic effect-marker bytes stored on the same fenced command attempt that recorded effectInvocationStartedAt.

awp_schemas_004_qa_intake_partial_conten.title: QA Intake Partial Content v1
awp_schemas_004_qa_intake_partial_conten.description: Structurally valid partial Draft content using exactly the canonical Feature 002 QA intake field vocabulary and value types. Canonical required user fields may be absent until deterministic validation reports VALID.

JSON Schema bounds the absolute index range but cannot express this instance-relative array-length constraint. The same validator requires ESTIMATE lower <= upper.

effortRange.description: A bounded non-authoritative estimate. Semantic validation requires lower <= upper; UNKNOWN carries no invented numeric estimate.

factRefs.description: Zero-based indexes into this assessment's facts array. Composed semantic validation rejects any index greater than or equal to facts.length.

StreamMetadata.description: Metadata returned beside the non-JSON bounded byte stream; artifact bytes are never embedded here.

launchConfirmation.description: Current server-issued launch/rerun summary. It is omitted when no action is currently permitted and is echoed unchanged with If-Match.

logicalExecutionContract.description: Provider-neutral pipeline/ref/result-job contract; the GitLab Profile maps these logical selectors to exact provider values.

normalizedInfrastructureCodes.description: Provider-error normalization vocabulary only; QA decides whether any code is retryable.

awp_contracts_commands_approval_subject_.title: Exact Approval Resource v2
awp_contracts_commands_approval_subject_.$comment: Additive successor to the frozen Approval v1 contract. EXTERNAL_COMMAND still requires exact Binding/Profile refs, external state and the full authorization basis. PLATFORM_ACTION instead requires its immutable queue-action-candidate@1.0.0/header snapshot plus a viewer-safe authorization-scope witness and explicitly forbids fabricated Connector refs or public entitlement/role-assignment record IDs. Its composed validator requires action.actionId = target.value.actionId = expectedLocalState.resourceRef.id; target.schemaRef is the exact registered candidate schema; payloadHash is the candidate JCS content hash; targetHash is the JCS hash of the complete SchemaBoundValue; expectedLocalState is the same candidate at version/resourceVersion/headerVersion 1, contentHash=payloadHash and currentPublishedVersion 0; Approval workspace/project, action command mapping, permission, separation policy, expiry and scope witness equal the candidate declarations. PROJECT witnesses equal candidate scope/target Workspace and Project plus requiredPermission; AUTHORIZED_PORTFOLIO witnesses equal candidate Workspace/authorizedProjectSetHash and the Approval Project equals the candidate target Project. A decision witness repeats that exact scope/permission for the current approver, and SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN requires a distinct HUMAN. subjectHash is recomputed from the documented immutable projection. The complete initiator/approver authorization basis remains private audit/execution evidence. Existing v1 bytes/readers remain unchanged; Core reads both schema IDs and creates v2 for new Feature 006 platform actions.

target.description: For Feature 006 PLATFORM_ACTION this SchemaBoundValue uses queue-action-candidate:v1 and contains only the public immutable candidate.

payloadHash.description: EXTERNAL_COMMAND: digest of the full payload SchemaBoundValue. PLATFORM_ACTION: semantic contentHash of the immutable candidate revision. For Feature 006 this is publicIntentHash, never the internal queue execution-witness actionHash.

currentPublishedVersion.description: 0 means that this aggregate has no current published/effective revision. Feature 006 pending action candidates use 0; action-specific internal witnesses are revalidated separately under the same transaction.

subjectHash.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785/JCS of the immutable subject projection: schema ID/version, scope, initiator plus branch-specific authorization evidence, action, target/targetHash/payloadHash, branch-specific expected state and Connector refs where applicable, permission, separation-of-duty, effect key, classification and expiry. It excludes subjectHash itself and decision/effect/resource lifecycle fields.

ProjectAuthorizationBasis.description: Private/external-command authorization provenance. Feature 006 PLATFORM_ACTION subjects never serialize this structure in the public Approval resource.

AuthorizationScopeWitness.description: Viewer-safe authorization evidence. It names no membership, entitlement or role-assignment record. Core retains the complete basis in private audit/execution storage and recomputes the current authorized Project set before every disclosure, decision and consumption.

projectAuthorizationFacetHash.description: Hash of the target-Project-only authorization outcome {workspaceId, projectId, requiredPermission, classificationDecision}; it never covers the actor's wider entitlement set.

awp_schemas_006_business_calendar_v1.title: BusinessCalendar v1
awp_schemas_006_business_calendar_v1.$comment: Composed validation resolves timeZone against the IANA database, requires non-overlapping startLocalTime < endLocalTime intervals, requires every dateOverrides.date to be unique across both CLOSED and WORKING variants (there is no precedence rule), requires validThrough >= validFrom when finite, validates overrides on or after validFrom and no later than a finite validThrough, and recomputes semanticHash. A null validThrough makes the immutable weekly recurrence and declared overrides authoritative for every future local date; only such an open-ended revision may be activated by a QueuePolicy. Intervals crossing midnight are represented as two intervals.

timeZone.description: Canonical IANA tzdb identifier, including link IDs such as UTC; fixed offsets and server-local aliases are rejected by composed validation.

validThrough.description: Inclusive final local date, or null for an open-ended immutable recurrence. QueuePolicy publication accepts only null so pinned SLA clocks and READY aging remain defined for an unbounded lifetime.

localTime.description: Second-precision wall-clock time; midnight-crossing intervals are split by date/day.

endLocalTime.description: Exclusive interval end. 24:00:00 is allowed only here so the first half of a midnight split is representable.

awp_schemas_006_capacity_admission_v1.title: CapacityAdmission v1
awp_schemas_006_capacity_admission_v1.$comment: Immutable public admission decision. Global capacity state/head versions/counts/set hashes and full authorization-basis hashes are deliberately absent because even bounded state changes could reveal hidden Project activity. before/after contain only the exact authorized-scope projection ref and public policy mode. The operation-local outcome/violations disclose only why this authorized target mutation did or did not occur. authorizationScopeWitnessHash covers only the target-Project authorization outcome. Mutation refs are a closed Project-safe allowlist correlated to activityKind: manual start/resume writes Session+claim, automated launch writes Session+reservation, automated review conversion writes Session+reservation+claim, automated release writes Session+reservation, external Jira reconciliation writes claims only, and SET/CLEAR/EXPIRE EXPEDITE writes exactly one Work Item queue-control revision. For a consumed override, composed validation resolves actionCandidateRef and approvalRef and requires: candidate actionId=actionCandidateRef.sourceId, publicIntentHash=actionCandidateRef.semanticHash, candidate actionKind/effect/target equal the admission override declarations and Work Item, and the Approval v2 actionId/target SchemaBoundValue/targetHash/payloadHash bind that same exact candidate. No private actionHash is serialized. Exact global witnesses and complete authorization bases remain internal to the admission transaction and stored action record. NON_DISCRETIONARY_OVERFLOW records an unavoidable fact; it is not approval.

authorizationScopeWitnessHash.description: Hash of {workspaceId, projectId, requiredPermission, classificationDecision}; it excludes membership/entitlement/role record IDs and every other Project.

policyFacetRef.description: Project-scoped public policy facet copied from the authorized read. The internal transaction separately pins the full Workspace policy revision.

semanticHash.description: Public Approval v2 subjectHash, never a private execution-witness hash.

publicIntentHash.description: Safe candidate/payload hash over caller-visible intent only. Semantic validation requires equality with actionCandidateRef.semanticHash; the internal execution-witness actionHash is never published.

awp_schemas_006_capacity_snapshot_v1.title: CapacitySnapshot v1
awp_schemas_006_capacity_snapshot_v1.$comment: Durable immutable public projection revision, not a read-time now evaluation. All counts, set hashes, facets and freshness are for the server-authorized scope only and count distinct Work Items. Global AVAILABLE/AT_LIMIT/OVER_CAPACITY/REBUILDING state is deliberately absent because even a bounded enum would reveal hidden-Project activity. In MEASURE_ONLY every Project facet has policy.state and warningState NOT_CONFIGURED. In ENFORCED a Project facet may remain NOT_CONFIGURED because Project limits are optional; for every facet warningState is NOT_CONFIGURED iff its policy is NOT_CONFIGURED. Composed validation checks committed as union(occupied,reserved), not their arithmetic sum, verifies each Project facet is in the authorized set, and recomputes authorizedProjectionRef.semanticHash from the full document excluding that ref wrapper.

authorizedProjectSetHash.description: PROJECT scope hashes the canonical singleton {projectId}; AUTHORIZED_PORTFOLIO hashes the exact server-derived visible set. It never hashes the actor's wider entitlements for a Project read.

policyFacetRef.description: Public policy facet for this exact authorized Project set. Its version/hash cover only authorization-neutral settings and allocations for that set; hidden-only policy changes cannot advance it.

authorizedProjectionRef.description: ID/version/hash of the immutable projection derived for this exact authorized Project set; never the internal global capacity head. semanticHash covers the complete document except this ref wrapper, so it is non-circular.

awp_schemas_qa_event_payload_automated_s.title: QA Automated Session Ready payload v1
awp_schemas_qa_event_payload_automated_s.$comment: Physical schema for the already-emitted qa.automated-session.ready outbox payload. Session and Work Item identities are UUIDs so the canonical EventEnvelope entityId can equal sessionId; referenced binding IDs retain their existing bounded opaque form. Workspace and Project scope remain in the canonical EventEnvelope. Registration under competency-qa@1.3.0 adds an exact declaration without rewriting historical events or the 1.2.0 manifest.

awp_schemas_006_qa_queue_facts_changed_v.title: QaQueueFactsChanged v1
awp_schemas_006_qa_queue_facts_changed_v.$comment: Immutable Project-scoped invalidation emitted after the QA queue-fact head transaction commits. Composed semantic validation requires changedFactKinds to equal the distinct factKind set in changedFactRefs and requires changedFactRefs to be canonically ordered. Consumers use the refs only to invalidate and re-read current authorized local facts; this payload contains no source content and grants no authorization.

awp_schemas_006_queue_action_candidate_v.title: QueueActionCandidate v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_action_candidate_v.$comment: Immutable caller-visible candidate used as the SchemaBoundValue target of a Core PLATFORM_ACTION Approval. publicIntentHash is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical bytes of this complete document. It deliberately contains only authorized read tokens; the paired internal queue-control-action witness and its global capacity fields are keyed by the same actionId but are not part of this document. For WIP resume, composed validation requires requestedSessionState to equal the pinned Session blockedFrom milestone; REVIEW_REQUIRED is valid only for MANUAL_SESSION_RESUME, while starts and launches request RUNNING.

requestHash.description: Canonical hash of the schema-closed caller DTO; it excludes trusted context and the raw idempotency key.

authorizedProjectSetHash.description: For PROJECT order scope this is the canonical singleton target Project; for AUTHORIZED_PORTFOLIO it is the exact server-derived visible set.

orderNoOpEffect.description: Terminal viewer-safe result produced before Approval creation when a BEFORE/AFTER anchor is absent from the already-authorized view. The requested anchor key remains only in the private witness/audit record.

originatingActionRef.description: Resolves the originating public SERVICE_CLASS_EXPEDITE candidate; semanticHash is that candidate's publicIntentHash.

awp_schemas_006_queue_control_action_v1.title: QueueControlAction v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_control_action_v1.$comment: Internal immutable queue execution witness paired by actionId with a separate public QueueActionCandidate used by the Core PlatformAction/Approval lifecycle. Authenticated actor and authorization results are trusted envelope context, not caller-supplied fields. Composed validation recomputes actionHash, verifies scope equality and rechecks every expected ref/version at consumption. For WIP resume, requestedSessionState must equal the pinned Session blockedFrom milestone; REVIEW_REQUIRED is valid only for MANUAL_SESSION_RESUME, while starts and launches request RUNNING. Capacity witnesses and actionHash never become the Core candidate contentHash/payloadHash and never appear in public views.

orderAnchor.description: Requested anchor key only. Resolution occurs inside the server-authorized base visible set; this object does not assert that the anchor exists.

queueEntryRef.description: Exact pre-authorized QueueEntry tuple supplied by the initiating read; consumption requires the same current revision and fingerprint.

expectedProjectionGeneration.description: Authorized-view semantic generation copied from QueuePage; never the internal Workspace rebuild-generation identity.

effortRange.description: Accepted planning metadata only; semantic validation requires lower <= upper. It is never a business-priority component.

orderNoOpEffect.description: Private terminal witness for a BEFORE/AFTER request whose anchor was absent after authorization filtering. requestedAnchor is retained for restricted audit/idempotency only and is never copied into the public candidate, Approval or receipt.

originatingActionRef.description: Resolves the originating public SERVICE_CLASS_EXPEDITE candidate; semanticHash is its publicIntentHash. originatingActionHash separately binds the paired private witness.

awp_schemas_006_queue_entry_v1.title: QueueEntry v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_entry_v1.$comment: This is one pre-authorized projection row. Source refs are structurally limited to Project-safe public families; composed validation verifies their property-specific type and same Workspace/Project scope, canonical source ordering/inputFingerprint, reducer/comparator output and all state-dependent invariants. Full policy/capacity/authorization records are never embedded. It never stores a final ordinal or opaque total score.

policyFacetRef.description: Project-scoped public policy facet. Its version/hash cover authorization-neutral Workspace settings plus this Project's applicable allocation only; a hidden-Project-only policy change cannot advance it.

publicSourceType.description: Closed public Project-safe source family. Full queue-policy, capacity-head and authorization-record families are forbidden.

reservationCauseSetHash.description: Hash of sorted exact cause refs for this Work Item's reservation only. It is never the Workspace-global reservation-set hash.

urgencyTiming.description: Exact comparator instant selected deterministically from the SLA latest-safe-start, SLA target, or confirmed Jira due-date end. Unknown and inapplicable states occupy closed stable buckets.

effortRange.description: Accepted planning metadata only; semantic validation requires lower <= upper. It is excluded from business-priority ordering.

readyAge.description: The comparator consumes the versioned agingBandKey; businessSeconds is explanatory elapsed working time sampled at QueueEntry.calculatedAt. A durable transition worker appends a new revision at the next aging-band boundary, so no per-second write is required.

awp_schemas_006_queue_order_view_invalid.title: QueueOrderViewInvalidated v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_order_view_invalid.$comment: Project-safe invalidation emitted only when the named Project lane order changed. A portfolio-only move/expiry never fans out this event to the target Project because that would disclose wider-scope activity. The payload carries no anchor, authorized Project-set hash, ordinal, action hash or free-text reason. invalidationRef.semanticHash is RFC 8785 over the complete payload excluding invalidationRef itself; envelope entityId/entityVersion equal workItemId/invalidationRef.version.

invalidationRef.description: Monotonic Project/WorkItem invalidation revision and non-circular public payload hash.

awp_schemas_006_queue_policy_v1.title: QueuePolicy v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_policy_v1.$comment: Composed publication validation resolves all refs in the same Workspace, requires statusMappingRef to identify the exact Jira status-mapping revision, recomputes semanticHash, rejects duplicate Project/goal/mapping keys, requires ordered non-overlapping aging/warning boundaries and checks warning < target plus reservedCapacity <= softWipLimit. The referenced BusinessCalendar must be open-ended (validThrough null). No value in this schema is a production WIP or SLA default.

awp_schemas_006_queue_stage_transition_v.title: QueueStageTransition v1
awp_schemas_006_queue_stage_transition_v.$comment: Immutable Project-scoped derived transition. Composed semantic validation requires previousStage to differ from currentStage, verifies both exact queue-entry refs in the same Workspace/Project scope, and checks that the referenced revisions carry the declared stages. It also verifies canonical reason-code order. This payload contains no content or authorization grant.

awp_schemas_006_sla_clock_transition_v1.title: SlaClockTransition v1
awp_schemas_006_sla_clock_transition_v1.$comment: Immutable Project-scoped public projection of one stored SLA clock revision. It contains transition-time facts only: no read-time asOf, freshness, remaining time, target evaluation or evaluationHash. clockRevisionRef.semanticHash is SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical bytes of this complete document with clockRevisionRef omitted. Composed validation requires clockRevisionRef.id=slaClockId, the envelope entityId/entityVersion to equal slaClockId/clockRevisionRef.version, exact previous-revision lineage, same-scope refs, source/goal compatibility, cumulative elapsed calculation at effectiveAt, and equality between START transitionSourceRef and startSourceRef. Cycle 1 START is revision 1 with no predecessor; a later-cycle START immediately follows and resolves the prior cycle's STOP revision under the same clock ID, increments clockCycle by one and starts a fresh lineage without changing prior facts.

awp_schemas_006_sla_snapshot_v1.title: SlaSnapshot v1
awp_schemas_006_sla_snapshot_v1.$comment: Read-time SLA evaluation. clockRevisionRef resolves the durable sla-clock-transition@1.0.0 projection and excludes dynamic evaluation fields; evaluationHash covers the full response except itself. For every started clock, composed validation requires exact field-for-field equality with that resolved transition for workspaceId, projectId, workItemId, goal, slaClockId, clockCycle, clockRevisionRef, policyFacetRef, calendarRef, mappingRef, algorithmRef, startSourceRef, startedAt, effectiveAt and inputFingerprint; clockState equals currentClockState and lastTransition equals transition. providerStartObservedAt is present iff the resolved start authority carries a provider observedAt (directly for Jira or through the rollout-verification receipt) and is equal to it. For STOP, stoppedAt and stopSourceRef equal transition effectiveAt and transitionSourceRef; for PAUSE, the pause reason/mapping/source/time equal mappedPauseReasonCode, mappingRef, transitionSourceRef and effectiveAt. targetConfiguration state, targetBusinessSeconds and the ordered warningThresholds equal the selected goal entry in the resolved policyFacetRef; remainingBusinessSeconds, computedTargetAt and targetState are derived only from that exact configuration, elapsedBusinessSeconds and the pinned calendar/algorithm. Composed validation calculates business seconds using the pinned open-ended calendar/algorithm, verifies the closed property-specific mapping/start/pause/segment/stop source families, enforces the goal-specific stop family, verifies segment lineage and requires every PAUSED boundary to resolve through the pinned closed mapping. Unknown reasons leave the clock RUNNING.

clockRevisionRef.description: Exact immutable clock transition revision. Its semanticHash excludes read-time asOf, elapsed/remaining evaluation and evaluationHash.

policyFacetRef.description: Project-scoped public policy facet; the internal clock retains the full source policy revision separately.

evaluationHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical response fields excluding evaluationHash itself. It changes with server-selected asOf or any derived elapsed/remaining value without mutating clockRevisionRef.

awp_schemas_006_sla_threshold_emission_v.title: SlaThresholdEmission v1
awp_schemas_006_sla_threshold_emission_v.$comment: Immutable Project-scoped threshold crossing and notification intent link. slaClockId plus clockRevisionRef identify the stored immutable transition revision; they do not pretend that the dynamic sla-snapshot read DTO is itself a revision. notificationIntentRef binds the durable intent ID to a hash of its immutable creation tuple and deliberately excludes its mutable delivery state/row version. Composed semantic validation resolves the exact internal clock/policy/calendar pins while publishing only the matching Project policy facet; verifies scope, clock cycle, target and elapsed business-second calculation; matches WARNING.warningIndex to the pinned ordered threshold; requires BREACH elapsedBusinessSeconds >= targetBusinessSeconds; and proves idempotencyHash from the canonical crossing identity. This payload contains no global capacity facts, source content or authorization grant.

clockRevisionRef.description: Exact immutable SLA clock transition revision. Its id equals slaClockId and its hash excludes read-time SLA evaluation fields.

policyFacetRef.description: Project-scoped public policy facet matching the clock snapshot; the internal clock keeps the full source policy revision.

notificationIntentRef.description: Stable reference to the existing mutable NotificationIntent header. creationHash is SHA-256 over the JCS immutable creation tuple (notificationIntentId, workspaceId, projectId, dedupeKey, sourceEventRef, targetHash, payloadHash, renderHash, commandId, expiresAt); mutable state, attempts and rowVersion are excluded.

awp_schemas_004_triage_assessment_v1_1.title: TriageAssessment v1.1
awp_schemas_004_triage_assessment_v1_1.$comment: Additive extension of Feature 004 triage-assessment@1.0.0. The base dimensions and recommendations shapes remain unchanged. The qa-triage@1.1 semantic output profile requires and correlates the optional v1.1 evidence fields, checks every factRefs value against facts.length, enforces ESTIMATE lower <= upper, verifies exact input-fingerprint canonicalization and checks ruleVersion/skillVersion against their refs. Fingerprint refs use closed property-specific public source families; composed validation also requires subject ref ID/version/hash equality with subject. No opaque total score is permitted.

policyRef.description: Feature 004 Project-scoped Hermes/triage execution-policy ref preserved from v1.0. It is not the Feature 006 Workspace QueuePolicy and contains no cross-Project allocation set.

effortRange.description: A bounded non-authoritative estimate. Semantic validation requires lower <= upper; UNKNOWN carries no invented numeric estimate.

factRefs.description: Zero-based indexes into this assessment's facts array. Composed semantic validation rejects any index greater than or equal to facts.length.

awp_schemas_007_artifact_retention_state.title: Artifact availability and retention projection v1

awp_schemas_007_binding_functional_accep.title: Binding functional acceptance wire projection v2
awp_schemas_007_binding_functional_accep.$comment: Explicit successor to the unimplemented v1 response: preserve exact accepted resource pins from the command and Core acceptance. No schema metadata is invented for externally owned policies. contentHash covers this wire projection without contentHash; AWP-Resource-Ref identifies the unchanged canonical Core record.

awp_schemas_007_evidence_package_v1.title: QA Work Item evidence package v1
